title: DeepSeek Harness tool payloads
description: Single source of truth for the harness tool payloads registered in src/deepseek_harness/tools.py (_TOOL_SCHEMAS): plan/plan_status, memory_store/memory_filter, checkpoint_create. TypeScript types are generated from this file by scripts/gen_ts_types.py. The write-side memory gate (src/deepseek_harness/memory_hygiene.py) exists because the HF discussion deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash#46 measured 12x memory bloat (161 KB vs 13 KB for the same conversation), with the excess made of decisions logs, self-advice, preambles and 109 'TBC' placeholders; prompt rules had zero effect, so contracts and gates live in code.

StepStatus.title: StepStatus
StepStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a plan step. Mirrors harness_server.models.PlanStatus and the enum in tools.plan_update_step.status.

PlanStep.title: PlanStep
PlanStep.description: One executable unit of a plan (harness_server.models.OKRPlanStep / tools.plan_update_step).

text.description: Step description, as returned by plan_create.

description.description: Optional human-facing summary of the step.

key.description: Key-result / milestone label, e.g. S1 or KR-A.

parent_id.description: Parent step id; null for top-level steps.

dependency_ids.description: Steps this step depends on (DAG edges).

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description: Plan payload returned by plan_create and consumed by plan_cascade.

task_description.description: Original task description passed to plan_create.

adjacency_list.description: Dependency graph: step_id -> ids of steps depending on it.

MemoryEntry.title: MemoryEntry
MemoryEntry.description: A memory record as accepted by memory_store and filtered by memory_filter (lambda_value).

content.description: Memory text. Must pass memory_hygiene.admit(): facts only.

lambda.description: Retrieval lambda (tools.memory_filter.lambda_value): 0.0 constraints only, 0.5 constraints+preferences+decisions, 1.0 everything.

source.description: Origin identifier used for dedupe (e.g. MEMORY.md).

plan_steps.description: Plan steps captured at snapshot time.

completed_step_ids.description: Ids of steps completed at snapshot time.

unexpected_findings.description: Findings that diverged from the plan.
